nl.title: Bestandsrechten (CHMOD) veilig zetten via de File Manager
nl.excerpt: Bestandsrechten (CHMOD) veilig zetten via de File Manager: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Via File Manager zet je CHMOD. Te open rechten (777) zijn een securityrisico; te strak maakt uploads kapot.

Richtlijnen

  • Mappen vaak 755; bestanden 644.
  • wp-config.php strakker (bijv. 600) indien van toepassing.
  • Geen 777 op hele trees “om het even te fixen”.

Procedure

  1. Selecteer bestand/map in File Manager.
  2. Pas rechten toe; test de functie (upload, plugin-install).
  3. Documenteer afwijkingen.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Malware; File Manager; SFTP.

en.title: Bestandsrechten (CHMOD) veilig set via the File Manager
en.excerpt: FTP/SFTP in DirectAdmin: account, home folder, connect with FileZilla.
en.bodyHtml:
“Bestandsrechten (CHMOD) veilig set via the File Manager”: FTP account with a limited home folder; prefer FTPS or SFTP.

Preparation

  • DirectAdmin login
  • FileZilla
  • Host from welcome email

Steps

  1. DirectAdmin → FTP Management → Create (or existing account).
  2. Limit Directory to the intended web root/subdirectory.
  3. FileZilla: host = server hostname, user/password, port 21 (FTPS) or 22 (SFTP).
  4. Choose explicit FTP over TLS or SFTP — not plain FTP.
  5. Upload a test file and confirm the path in the browser.

Verify

  • Stable connection
  • Test file on expected URL

Tip: SFTP is often more stable behind strict firewalls.

Note: Do not use 777 permissions ‘to make it work’.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: File Manager, permissions, SFTP.
